title: Three Pigs in Love
description: Three anthropomorphic pigs in a cozy living room: a green pig lounging on the floor blowing heart bubbles, a large pink pig smiling happily in an orange armchair, and a pink pig with a rose on its head standing and emitting heart-shaped smoke. Red rose petals are scattered on the coffee table and rug.
